D: A noodle shop panda is chosen as the Dragon Warrior and has to defend the Valley of Peace.
P: Serve the dumplings when Shifu trains Po with a bowl of them.
S: Shifu trains Po by making him fight for the last dumpling
Pork and cabbage dumplings folded with ginger and spring onion, steamed 8 minutes, with a soy, black vinegar and chilli oil dip. Chopsticks only.
grilled until caramelised, honey, whipped ricotta and crushed almonds, from the sacred tree
Ripe peaches halved, grilled cut side down until caramelised, drizzled with honey and served with whipped ricotta and crushed almonds.
Mr Ping's red bean steamed buns
soft fluffy dough filled with sweet paste, stacked high in bamboo, hot from the noodle shop

Soft, fluffy white steamed buns filled with sweet red bean paste, stacked high in a bamboo steamer and served hot. Mix 300g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 40g caster sugar, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 160ml warm milk and 1 tbsp oil. Knead 8 minutes until smooth and prove 1 hour. Divide into 12, flatten each, fill with a tablespoon of red bean paste and pinch closed. Sit each on a square of baking paper in a bamboo steamer, prove 20 minutes, then steam over boiling water for 12 minutes.
M: ginger chicken broth with soy and white pepper over wheat noodles and bok choy, nothing hidden

Chicken bones simmered 3 hours with ginger, garlic and spring onion, strained, seasoned with soy and white pepper, poured over hand-pulled or fresh wheat noodles with bok choy and shredded chicken. The secret is there isn't one.
Valley of Peace kung pao chicken
diced thigh tossed with dried chilli, Sichuan pepper and peanuts, sweet sour glaze, skadoosh

Diced chicken thigh stir-fried hot with dried chilli, Sichuan pepper, spring onion and roasted peanuts in a glossy sweet and sour sauce, with steamed rice. Toss 800g diced chicken thigh with 1 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp cornflour. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp black vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp cornflour and 60ml water for the sauce. Stir-fry 8 dried chillies and 1 tsp Sichuan pepper in hot oil for 20 seconds, add the chicken and cook 5 minutes. Add 3 garlic cloves, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in 80g roasted peanuts and serve with rice.
W: butter, sugar and almond meal rounds, a nut on top, baked golden, for the Furious Five
Butter, sugar and almond meal cookies with an almond pressed on top, egg washed and baked at 170C for 14 minutes until golden.
K: chilled green tea with fresh fruit purée and honey over ice, there are no accidents

Jasmine green tea brewed and chilled, mixed with fresh peach purée and honey, poured over ice with peach slices. Steep 4 jasmine green tea bags in 1 litre water at 80C for 3 minutes, then remove and chill. Blend 2 ripe peeled peaches with 2 tbsp honey and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Stir the purée into the cold tea. Pour over ice in tall glasses with thin peach slices.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and re-steam 5 minutes before serving

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl, then add the warm milk and oil and bring together into a dough.
Knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove in a warm spot for 1 hour.
Divide into 12, flatten each piece, fill with a tablespoon of red bean paste and pinch closed. Sit each bun on a square of baking paper in a bamboo steamer.
Cover and prove the buns for another 20 minutes.
Steam over boiling water for 12 minutes and serve hot, stacked in the steamer.

steps.text: Put the frames in a pot with the ginger, garlic and spring onions and cover with the water.
Simmer gently for 3 hours, skimming now and then, then strain. Poach the chicken thighs in the stock for the last 15 minutes.
Season the stock with soy and white pepper and shred the chicken.
Cook the noodles and bok choy briefly, then pour the hot stock over them with the chicken. The secret is there isn't one.

veg.make_ahead: Stock up to 3 days ahead, or freeze

steps.text: Put the shiitake mushrooms, onion, carrots, ginger, garlic and spring onions in a large pot and cover with the water.
Simmer gently for 1 hour, then strain. Keep the shiitake mushrooms, trim off the stalks and slice the caps.
Season the stock with the soy sauce and white pepper. Cut the tofu into cubes and warm it in the stock for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles and bok choy briefly, then pour the hot stock over them with the tofu and sliced shiitake. The secret is there isn't one.

dishes.n: Valley of Peace kung pao chicken
dishes.make_ahead: Toss the chicken in the soy and cornflour and mix the sauce up to 1 day ahead, chilled; stir-fry and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Rinse the jasmine rice, then simmer covered in 450ml water on low for 15 minutes and rest off the heat.

Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the 1 tbsp cornflour for the chicken. Mix the remaining 3 tbsp soy, the black vinegar, sugar, the cornflour for the sauce and 60ml water for the sauce.
Slice the garlic, grate the ginger and cut the spring onions into 3cm lengths.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot, stir-fry the dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds, then add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in the peanuts and serve with the rice.

veg.n: Valley of Peace kung pao tofu
veg.make_ahead: Press and cube the tofu up to 1 day ahead and mix the sauce up to 2 days ahead, both chilled; coat, fry and cook the rice on the night

steps.text: Rinse the jasmine rice, then simmer covered in 450ml water on low for 15 minutes and rest off the heat.

Pat the tofu dry, toss with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce and the 2 tbsp cornflour for the tofu. Mix the remaining 3 tbsp soy, the black vinegar, sugar, the cornflour for the sauce and 60ml water for the sauce.
Slice the garlic, grate the ginger and cut the spring onions into 3cm lengths.
Heat the oil in a wok until very hot, stir-fry the dried chillies and Sichuan peppercorns for 20 seconds, then add the tofu and fry for 5 to 6 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and spring onion, then the sauce, and toss until glossy. Stir in the peanuts and serve with the rice.
Beat the butter and sugar, then mix in the almond meal and flour.
Roll into 16 balls, press an almond on each and brush with egg.
Bake at 170C until golden.
